zh-Hans.name: 言道国学
zh-Hans.subtitle: 原典阅读、图谱研习与学习交流
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 把原典、图谱与学习同好连在一起。阅读经典、连续听学、练习复习，结合人体图谱、天文历法与学习讨论，逐步整理自己的知识。
zh-Hans.keywords: 国学,古籍,传统文化,经典阅读,中医学习,经络穴位,三维人体,历法,节气,天文,学习交流
zh-Hans.description:
言道国学把国学原典、中医文献、学习练习、人体图谱、天文历法与学习交流放在一起，让阅读、观察、练习和讨论相互连接。

【读原典，也能复习】
按书籍、篇章与关键词查找已收录资料，配合连续听学、学习笔记、章节练习和错题复习，逐步整理自己的知识。原文与学习整理分别呈现，请结合资料标注的版本和来源核对。

【看图谱，也看资料】
在三维人体中旋转、缩放、按组织系统观察，使用隐藏、只看、撤销和恢复等操作理解结构。中文经络与穴位名称联系已有图文、循行动图和相关资料，便于往返对照。模型包需联网下载，验证成功后可在本机使用。点位和图谱属于学习示意，不是临床精准取穴工具。

【学习交流，保留自己的选择】
通过动态、评论、好友私信和学习群分享心得。在同辰雅集中，成年人可自愿选择出生条件和兴趣寻找学习同好；携盘交流与活盘链接用于讨论具体学习案例。私人档案不会自动公开，分享前可选择内容和接收对象。支持举报、拉黑、退出与账号删除，公开发布和发送须满足账号及内容安全要求。

【天文历法与传统文化研习】
结合天文馆、节气、日历和现有易学工具，理解传统排算方法、术语与文化背景，记录并对照学习案例。同辰条件、盘面和AI解释不代表对婚姻、财富、健康或命运的事实预测，不代替现实决策。

【中医文献与学习笔记】
查阅已收录的中医文献、药材、方剂和经络资料，按术语对照原文。古籍记载、现代整理、用户经历与AI辅助内容应分别理解；不应直接用于个人诊断、治疗、用药或操作。身体不适请咨询合资格医务人员。

【自己的学习记录】
结合日历、笔记与本机私人记录整理学习安排。下载资料后可使用相应离线内容，在线交流和账号服务需要网络。主要导航和操作按钮支持简体、繁体、日语与英语，典籍及课程保留原文。

基础学习与可选付费权益以应用内说明为准。iOS版数字会员和AI点数通过App Store购买，已购买可在会员页面恢复购买；消耗型点数的已交付与余额以原应用账号账本为准。AI辅助内容可能有误，请核对原文与可靠资料。
zh-Hans.whatsNew: 改进离线资料下载与断点恢复，校验及存储失败时保留原有效资料；完善中医文献和经络资料页的结果排版；修复学习视频链接识别与旧AV号打开问题；统一相关学习说明，并改进苹果版文献学习页的会员、AI点数与恢复购买入口。

reviewNotes:
Yandao Guoxue 25.0.115 (53) is a Chinese classical-text and structured learning application. Please start with Home > introductory learning, original texts and listening, then the medical-text library, practice questions, anatomy/meridian references, calendar and astronomy. These are real bundled application screens, not a review-only website. Traditional Bazi, Ziwei, Liuren and other calculation tools remain visible as cultural study tools; the listing does not conceal them or claim factual predictions, guaranteed compatibility, financial outcomes or treatment effects.

What changed in build 53: interrupted offline downloads retain received bytes; verified bytes, installed index and metadata commit together, leaving the prior valid pack intact on failure. Two medical-text/meridian result views now use the existing safe text renderer for headings, emphasis and lists without executing model HTML. Public learning-video link parsing validates actual platform hosts and correctly opens legacy AV links. The iOS literature-learning purchase prompt now links to the existing App Store membership, AI-credit and restore pages rather than an external single-unlock checkout. Existing prices and product IDs are unchanged.

The review login is provided only in Apple's dedicated account fields. It has the same monthly learning entitlement available to ordinary subscribers, granted for review without payment, and is enabled for server-verified Apple Sandbox receipts. Profile > membership and Profile > AI credits show the eight existing products. Restore uses the same application account; consumable credit recovery depends on the server ledger rather than a claim that StoreKit restores spent consumables. Do not pay twice if a transaction is pending.

Existing social features include moderated posts/comments, friends, private messages, study groups, voluntary adult Tongchen and authorized chart sharing. No random anonymous chat. Report/block/contact/delete-account paths remain available. Private birth/health/life records do not automatically enroll in matching or become public; sharing requires selection and preview. Account verification and content moderation apply to ordinary users and reviewers alike. No fabricated phone verification or review-only feature unlocking.

Anatomy/meridian illustrations, the original circulation animations and limited licensed photographs are educational references. We do not claim professional validation of every point coordinate or complete photographic coverage. Classical and medical material is distinguished from user experience and AI-assisted explanation; sources and notices remain accessible. AI can be inaccurate and is not a substitute for reliable sources or professional care.

Some cross-device and physical-device acceptance items remain separately tracked; simulator screenshots and successful builds are not claimed as a complete medical or device certification. Reviewer account posting access must be verified before formal resubmission.
submissionBlockers: Existing formal build36 and eight IAPs are still waiting for review; preserve this state until a complete replacement is ready, then perform one controlled replacement rather than a duplicate submission.

The dedicated review account can log in, use its granted monthly learning entitlement and obtain a 3D download link, but phoneVerified is false; real posting/messaging access must be resolved without inventing verification.
Fresh same-source iPhone/iPad simulator screenshots and final package resource verification must finish before saving/submitting the replacement.
